_comment: PhantomNet Sprint Config — Week 20 (Month 5 Week 4: Integration, Testing & V3 Release Prep, Days 36-40)
milestone_description: Implementation of local LLM narrative integration, TAXII feed server, MITRE ATT&CK visualization, PDF export, and batch operations.

tasks.Title: Month 5 Retrospective and Week 20 Planning
tasks.Objective: Review Month 5 progress across Sentinel V3 features and plan the V3.0 release candidate schedule.
Tasks: Conduct month 5 retrospective meeting.
Review open issues and bugs related to TAXII, LLM, and PDF generation.
Finalize V3.0 release goals.
Deliverables: Month 5 retrospective document in docs/retrospective/month5_retrospective.md.

tasks.Title: TAXII Server Load Testing
tasks.Objective: Test STIX feed distribution under high concurrent load to ensure TAXII server stability.
Tasks: Use locust or JMeter to simulate multiple SIEM clients pulling STIX bundles.
Measure response latency and TAXII server memory footprint.
Optimize pagination and database queries for the STIX feed.
Deliverables: TAXII load testing report and implemented optimizations.

tasks.Title: LLM Integration Stress Test
tasks.Objective: Evaluate local Ollama/Mistral LLM performance for concurrent playbook narrative generation.
Tasks: Trigger multiple simultaneous LLM prompt generations.
Monitor GPU/CPU usage and generation time.
Implement request queuing to prevent LLM service crash under heavy load.
Deliverables: LLM stress test results and request queuing implementation.

tasks.Title: E2E Dashboard Testing for Sentinel V3
tasks.Objective: Implement automated UI tests for Sentinel V3 dashboard flows (Review, Approve, Export).
Tasks: Write Cypress/Playwright scripts for the Playbook workflow.
Test multi-select batch approval UI.
Test PDF and STIX download actions.
Deliverables: E2E test suite for Sentinel V3 in frontend-dev/cypress/e2e/.

tasks.Title: Update Sentinel V3 API Documentation
tasks.Objective: Ensure all new endpoints (TAXII, Batch, Export, Auto-gen) are properly documented in Swagger/OpenAPI.
Tasks: Update docstrings in FastAPI route handlers.
Verify OpenAPI JSON output includes new models (STIX, Playbook).
Export static API documentation for external integrators.
Deliverables: Updated OpenAPI documentation and static HTML docs.

tasks.Title: Security Audit of Sentinel Layer
tasks.Objective: Audit batch approve/reject endpoints, TAXII auth, and PDF generation for security vulnerabilities.
Tasks: Test for Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) in playbook endpoints.
Verify TAXII basic auth/JWT validation.
Check PDF generation for path traversal and XSS.
Deliverables: Security audit findings and patched vulnerabilities.

tasks.Title: Playbook Template Optimization
tasks.Objective: Refine Jinja2 templates for better readability and more accurate STIX/MITRE mapping.
Tasks: Update Markdown templates to improve executive summary layout.
Ensure all Snort and Sigma rules are formatted correctly within playbooks.
Optimize template rendering speed.
Deliverables: Optimized Jinja2 templates in backend/sentinel/templates/.

tasks.Title: UI Accessibility and Polish
tasks.Objective: Fix contrast, ARIA labels, and responsive layout for the new Sentinel panels.
Tasks: Run Lighthouse accessibility audit on Sentinel Dashboard.
Fix color contrast warnings in dark/light modes.
Ensure tables and batch actions are keyboard navigable.
Deliverables: Accessibility fixes and 100% Lighthouse accessibility score.

tasks.Title: Setup CI/CD pipeline for TAXII server and LLM tests
tasks.Objective: Add Month 5 test suites to GitHub Actions to prevent regressions in Sentinel V3 features.
Tasks: Update .github/workflows/python-app.yml to include TAXII feed tests.
Mock LLM responses in CI/CD pipeline.
Ensure PDF generation dependencies are installed in CI runner.
Deliverables: Updated GitHub Actions pipeline passing all Month 5 tests.

tasks.Title: MITRE ATT&CK Framework Update
tasks.Objective: Ensure the latest ATT&CK techniques (v14+) are mapped properly in the Sentinel layer.
Tasks: Update MITRE ATT&CK JSON mappings.
Verify tactic and technique IDs for all 12 mapped attack scenarios.
Validate STIX objects reference the correct external references.
Deliverables: Updated MITRE ATT&CK mapping definitions.

tasks.Title: Optimize Model Inference for Sentinel
tasks.Objective: Cache LLM responses and optimize RAM usage during auto-generation.
Tasks: Implement Redis caching for identical attack narrative prompts.
Reduce memory footprint of the anomaly detection pipeline.
Document hardware requirements for optimal V3 performance.
Deliverables: Caching implementation and V3 hardware sizing guide.

tasks.Title: Dashboard Metrics Validation
tasks.Objective: Ensure the stats panel shows accurate aggregate numbers and matches backend database state.
Tasks: Validate UI metric cards (Total, Approved, Rejected) against DB queries.
Fix any chart rendering glitches with zero-data states.
Optimize API polling intervals for dashboard stats.
Deliverables: Accurate, glitch-free dashboard analytics panel.

tasks.Title: V3.0 Release Candidate Preparation
tasks.Objective: Draft release notes, changelog, and migration guides for Month 5 features.
Tasks: Update CHANGELOG.md with Month 5 features.
Draft V3.0 release notes.
Write database migration instructions for V2 to V3 transition.
Deliverables: CHANGELOG.md and V3.0 release notes.

tasks.Title: Penetration Testing on Honeypots
tasks.Objective: Verify deception layer stability and data integrity with all Month 5 pipeline changes active.
Tasks: Run Nmap, Nikto, and Hydra against the 4 honeypots.
Verify that the V3 Sentinel layer successfully categorizes the attacks.
Confirm Snort/Sigma rules and playbooks are generated without errors.
Deliverables: Penetration testing execution report and verified artifacts.

tasks.Title: Auto-Scheduler Robustness Testing
tasks.Objective: Test edge cases and failure recovery for the background playbook scheduler.
Tasks: Simulate database lock timeouts during generation.
Simulate LLM API failures to ensure grace degradation (fallback to templated playbook).
Verify email alerts trigger properly on critical failures.
Deliverables: Robustness test results and error handling fixes.

tasks.Title: Cross-Browser Compatibility
tasks.Objective: Test the Sentinel dashboard and PDF export on Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
Tasks: Verify responsive layout and flexbox behavior across browsers.
Ensure PDF Blob download works correctly in Safari and Firefox.
Fix any browser-specific CSS rendering issues.
Deliverables: Cross-browser compatibility validation and fixes.

tasks.Title: Final Sign-off and Merge
tasks.Objective: Review all Month 5 PRs, merge to main, and tag the V3.0 release candidate.
Tasks: Perform final code reviews on integration testing fixes.
Merge development branch to main.
Tag git release v3.0.0-rc1.
Deliverables: Merged main branch and v3.0.0-rc1 tag.

tasks.Title: Incident Response Playbook Validation
tasks.Objective: Validate generated PDFs, STIX bundles, and Markdown playbooks against real SOC expectations.
Tasks: Review generated playbooks for actionable intelligence.
Verify STIX bundles can be imported into external tools (e.g., MISP, OpenCTI).
Confirm Snort rules compile without syntax errors.
Deliverables: Playbook and Artifact validation sign-off.

tasks.Title: Final ML Performance Report
tasks.Objective: Document precision/recall, latency, and resource usage for the final Month 5 architecture.
Tasks: Generate ROC/AUC curves for the ensemble model.
Document end-to-end latency (from packet capture to STIX bundle).
Finalize the model_capabilities.yaml documentation.
Deliverables: ML Performance Report for V3.0.

tasks.Title: Presentation Demo Prep
tasks.Objective: Record a demo video of the Sentinel V3 workflow for the final project presentation.
Tasks: Script the demo flow (Attack -> Detection -> Playbook -> Approval -> Export).
Record 1080p screen capture of the dashboard in action.
Edit video and add annotations for the final submission.
Deliverables: Sentinel V3 demonstration video.
